# Summary for Lay Audience {.unnumbered}

<!-- Required. Max 350 words, written for readers without prior knowledge of the field. -->

Did raising the pay of new recruits at the Wall scare away enlistment, as the Lords of
the Seven Kingdoms feared? To find out, this thesis compares a castle that raised pay
with a similar castle that did not, before and after the change. If both castles were
on the same path before, the difference in how they changed afterwards shows the effect
of the policy. Economists have used this idea for more than a century, and it has
become a standard tool for evaluating policies.
